profile.headline: Software Engineer VII at vitapoly inc
profile.summary:
Dedicated and experienced technical professional seeking a new career path to apply my passion to work with children and people to drive positive change in my community.


Specialties: 

Languages: C/C++, QT, Java, PHP, SQL, WSH/VBScript, Tcl/Expect, Perl, Pascal, ActionScript

Software Development: Design, UML

Windows Technologies: ADSI, COM, WMI, Win32 API, MFC

Java Technologies:  JSP, Servlet, J2EE, JDBC, Tomcat

Web Technologies: Adobe Flex, XML, XSLT, XML-Schema, DTD, (X)HTML, CSS, JavaScript, NodeJs, REST API, YAML

Network Simulators: Cisco PacketTracer, J-Sim, NS2

Networking: RFC Implementation, CCNA, CCNP

Protocols: DHCP (v4, v6), DNS (v4, v6), RIP (v4, v6), OSPF (v4, v6), EIGRP (v4, v6), REP, LLDP, SNMP, HTTP, UDP, TCP,  IP (v4, v6), DAI, IP Fragmentation (v4, v6), PMTU, Ethernet, 802.11a/b/g

Relational Databases: Oracle, MySQL

IoT: raspberry pi, arduino, sensors

Testing: Squish, unit

Platforms: Linux, Unix, Windows, IOS

positions.title: Software Engineer VII
positions.description:
Working on the following versions of Cisco Packet Tracer:

Cisco Packet Tracer 9.0:
- Implemented the firewall feature for ISA 3000
- Implemented the  Parallel Redundancy Protocol (PRP) 
- Implemented the Cisco switch IE-3400

Cisco Packet Tracer 8.2

Cisco Packet Tracer 8.1 and 8.1.1:
- Worked on the AAAA DNS query feature

Cisco Packet Tracer 8.0:
- Participated in the implementation of the network controller device that discovers network devices and hosts,  retrieves data and applies some settings onto them.
- Defined the North-bound REST API in YAML format and implemented those APIs.

Cisco Packet Tracer 7.3.1:
- Implemented SLAAC, DHCPv6 Stateless and Statefull, and IPv6 Prefix Delegation  features.
- Implemented Netsh interface IPv6 show neighbors command

Cisco Packet Tracer 7.3:
- Implemented the Cisco Wireless LAN Controller WLC-3504 for Packet Tracer.
- Implemented Dynamic ARP Inspection (DAI) for Packet Tracer.

CTF Game:
- Worked on the C++ REST APIs for the communication between the client and server.

Cisco Packet Tracer 7.2:
- Implemented a simplified version of the Meraki Security Appliance (SA) MX65W for Packet Tracer.
- Implemented a simplified Meraki cloud for administrating, configuring and monitoring security appliances.
- Implemented the address prefix command for the stateful IPv6 DHCP pool.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I was in the Cisco Simulation, Game, and Mobile Engineering (SGME) Group.

Worked on the following versions of Cisco Packet Tracer:

Cisco Packet Tracer 7.1:
- Implemented the central switching and authentication for Wireless LAN Controller (WLC).
- Implemented the internal DHCP server for WLC.

Cisco Packet Tracer 7.0: 
- Implemented Cisco ISR 819HG-4G-IOX.
- Implemented DHCP layer 2: Server Port-Based Address Allocation.
- Implementing Cisco proprietary Resilient Ethernet Protocol (REP).
- Implemented LLDP (Layer Link Discovery Protocol).

Cisco Packet Tracer 6.2:
- Implemented Packet Tracer features for the Internet of Everything.
- Implemented Cisco ISR 819HGW for Packet Tracer.
- Implemented Cisco 802 Access Point embedded in 819HGW.

Cisco Packet Tracer 6.1:
- Worked on the QT 4.8 conversion.
- Designed and implemented OSPF neighbor commands for IP and IPv6.
- Designed and implemented DHCPv6 server backend code for Packet Tracer Servers.
- Designed and implemented DHCP Snooping for switches.
- Implemented the ASA device for Packet Tracer.
- Worked on default-information originate for RIPng.
- Implemented IOS 15.0 for Switch 2960.

Cisco Packet Tracer 6.0: 
- Researched and wrote design documents
- Implemented the new ISR G2 routers and IOS 15
- Fixed bugs

Cisco Packet Tracers 5.3.3 and  5.3.2: 
- Worked as a team lead, providing support, making builds and fixing bugs.

Cisco Packet Tracer is a visualized network simulation used for teaching, configuring and debugging real world scenarios.

http://www.cisco.com/web/learning/netacad/course_catalog/PacketTracer.html

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I worked with the Cisco Instructional Research and Technology R&D team:

Cisco Packet Tracer 5.3.1:
- Worked as a team lead, providing support to the team.
- Did documentation, made builds, and fixed bugs.

Cisco Packet Tracer 5.3:
- Implemented HWIC-AP-AG-B (Cisco 802.11 A/B/G Access Point High Speed Wan Interface Card)
- Worked on Linksys enhancement.

Cisco Packet Tracer 5.2.1:
- Worked on DHCP for IPv6 enhancement.

Cisco Packet Tracer 5.2:
- Implemented "auto secure" command on Packet Tracer Cisco routers.
- Implemented SNMP.
- Implemented the improved TCP/IP framework, including IP fragmentation, IPv6 fragmentation with PMTU Discovery, TCP segmentation, TCP windowing, and Nagle algorithm.

Cisco Packet Tracer 5.0:
- Implemented DHCP for IPv6.
- Implemented IPv6 general prefix.
- Implemented IPv6 stateless auto configuration.

Maintained and enhanced the Cisco ActivitySequencer, an Adobe Flex template for creating multilevel game-like experiences within Packet Tracer.

Maintained and enhanced the Cisco ActivityGrader, a java application to open all activities in a given folder in Packet Tracer, to extract the grade and to output a csv file with the filename and the percentage correct.

Wrote an installer for the ActivitySequencer and the Healthy Network Game using Inno Setup with a customized Pascal script to allow Packet Tracer validation and  the installation of an AIR application via Adobe Air.  View the installer on YouTube:
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OwT9qEZ9wo4

Implemented a prototype for the traffic translation tool that snips live traffic on an ethernet adapter and translates it into Packet Tracer traffic, and vice versa.  The tool is implemented with C++ and WinPCap.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Fixed bugs for CyberArts online poker game distribution to Mansion

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the research, analysis, documentation, and development of the backend code for the Teneros AppChecker, a Windows client application used to collect and analyze a customer’s network infrastructure to correctly scale and match the performance characteristics to one of Teneros’ high availability Microsoft Exchange appliance products. The multi-threaded backend code was implemented as a COM server, using C++, ATL, boost API, ADSI, WMI, MAPI, sockets, remote registry queries, log parsing, regular expressions, MS-XML, and DOM parsing.  The tool supports the asynchronous calling scheme between UI and the backend code, which was integrated through COM.

Responsible for implementing the Golden Image/Factory Installation Verification Tool which is used by Manufacturing to validate the golden image Windows disk, Linux disk, and Teneros appliances after factory installation, using WSH/VBScript, C++, 3ware API, WMI, registry query, and ADSI.

positions.title: Networking Academy R&D Contractor
positions.description: Responsible for the implementation of the simulation scheduler framework and various protocols for the Cisco’s Packet Tracer version 4.0, a network simulation application used for designing, configuring, and troubleshooting network topologies. It is an educational tool for Cisco Networking Academy CCNA and CCNP students worldwide. The application was implemented using C++ and QT API. I worked on the implementation of the following network protocols: Ethernet, CSMA/CD, RIP versions 1 and 2, UDP, simulated STP, and simulated wireless 802.11.  I also implemented the activity wizard to allow instructors to set up interactive network labs for students.

positions.title: Software Automation Intern
positions.description: Worked on automation scripts to provision the Integrated Digital Loop Carrier on a broadband network element. I also enhanced the existing SNMP automation library and developed a remote interaction automation library for the following test equipment: AMERITEC BCG and SAGE.

positions.title: Graduate Intern
positions.description: Designed and implemented the Sun finance intranet web site to update and display dynamic content with a search engine using JSP and XML. The XML database management application for the database content administrative configuration was implemented using JSP. Implemented a password protected administration site used to manage the dynamic content including set up of search content and keywords.

positions.title: IP Networking R&D Contractor
positions.description:
Implemented traffic generation models for the Network Simulation Project following Poisson and constant rate arrivals. The simulator was written in J-Sim environment, used for analysis of network misconfiguration at the layer 3. Simulated HTTP traffic sessions using Pareto distribution. Assisted in enhancing J-Sim with RFC 2988: Computing TCP's Retransmission Timer. Modeled faulty packet filtering misconfiguration and DoS attack.

Implemented UI functionality for the Misconfiguration Detection Tool, a web interface of a duplex misconfiguration detection tool.  The tool is used to detect the half-duplex and full-duplex misconfiguration in network links.  The GUI was implemented using JSP and Servlets.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Implemented GUI panels using JSP and Servlet for Volera’s System Controller, a network management application, used to manage a large number of caching appliances from a central point.

Implemented RTSP streaming statistics counters to collect data and display on the system console screen using C/C++ and on the GUI using Java for the Streaming Media Cache, an add-on to the Novell’s Internet Caching System, supporting streaming and caching over QuickTime and Microsoft Windows Media players.
